theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_A8
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hcl : classicalFrag φ) : collapse res Σ φ = φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_A9
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (v : IndeterminateExpr) (hv : classicalFrag v) (hres : res Σ φ = some v) : collapse res Σ φ = syntacticCollapse (some v) φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_classical_fragment_stable
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hcl_res : ∀ v, res Σ φ = some v → res Σ (syntacticCollapse (some v) φ) = some v) : ∀ ψ : IndeterminateExpr, classicalFrag ψ → collapse res Σ ψ = ψ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_div_zero_form
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (e : IndeterminateExpr) (v : IndeterminateExpr) (hv : classicalFrag v) (hform : Σ.equations.any (fun eq => eq.lhs == IndeterminateExpr.indeterminate && eq.rhs == binOp OpSymbol.Div e (const 0)) = true) (res_correct : res Σ (binOp OpSymbol.Div e (const 0)) = some v) : collapse res Σ (binOp OpSymbol.Div e (const 0)) = v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_idempotent
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ : IndeterminateExpr) (hstable : ∀ v, res Σ φ = some v → res Σ v = some v) : collapse res Σ (collapse res Σ φ) = collapse res Σ φ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_implies_rewrite_star
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (res : MetaArithmeticState → IndeterminateExpr → Option IndeterminateExpr) (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (φ v : IndeterminateExpr) (hcol : collapse res Σ φ = v) (hv : classicalFrag v) : RewriteStar Σ φ v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.TIF.collapse_recovery
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : MetaArithmeticState) (v : IndeterminateExpr) (hv : classicalFrag v) (res_correct : res Σ indeterminate = some v) : collapse res Σ indeterminate = v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.adm_empty
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) : Adm (State.empty) v

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.blocked_of_vacuous
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : State α) (e : Expr α) (hvac : ∀ v : Valuation α, ¬ Adm Σ v) : isBlocked Σ e

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.classical_collapse_agreement
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : State α) (e : CExpr α) (v₀ : Valuation α) (c : α) (hadm : ∀ v : Valuation α, Adm Σ v ↔ v = v₀) (heval : evalC v₀ e = some c) : Collapse' Σ (CExpr.embed e) = some c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.collapse'_none_iff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (Σ : State α) (e : Expr α) : Collapse' Σ e = none ↔ ¬(∃ c : α, (∃ v : Valuation α, Adm Σ v) ∧ UniquelyResolves Σ e c)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_add
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.add e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => some (a + b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_const
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (c : α) : evalC v (CExpr.const c) = some c

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_div
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.div e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => if b = 0 then none else some (a / b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_div_nonzero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) (a b : α) (h₁ : evalC v e₁ = some a) (h₂ : evalC v e₂ = some b) (hb : b ≠ 0) : evalC v (CExpr.div e₁ e₂) = some (a / b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_eq_eval
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} [Add α] [Sub α] [Mul α] [Div α] [DecidableEq α] [Zero α] (v : Valuation α) (e : CExpr α) : evalC v e = eval v (CExpr.embed e)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_mul
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.mul e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => some (a * b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.name: TIF.evalC_sub
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (e₁ e₂ : CExpr α) : evalC v (CExpr.sub e₁ e₂) = match evalC v e₁, evalC v e₂ with | some a, some b => some (a - b) | _, _ => none

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (v : Valuation α) (x : String) : evalC v (CExpr.var x) = some (v x)
